name: v1.5 Enhanced — Up to date with the original Android port (v0.9.3)
body:
# v1.5 Enhanced — Up to date with the original Android port (v0.9.3)

This version brings in the latest updates of the Android port this fork comes from
(GreenNaugahyde's v0.9.1, v0.9.2 and v0.9.3), merged with this fork's own features.

**The APK contains no game files, no game code and no keys.** It installs over any earlier version
and keeps your saves and settings.

## Installing

Install the APK over any earlier version. Requirements: Android 11 or newer, 64-bit ARM,
Vulkan 1.1, about 2 GB of free storage and memory.

If the app crashes, share the log it offers at the next start (or from *About*) with your report.

name: v1.4 Enhanced — Up to date with the original Android port (v0.9)
body:
# v1.4 Enhanced — Up to date with the original Android port (v0.9)

This version brings in everything from the latest version of the Android port this fork comes from
(GreenNaugahyde's v0.8 and v0.9), merged with this fork's own features.

**The APK contains no game files, no game code and no keys.** It installs over any earlier version
and keeps your saves and settings. At its first start the game code is prepared again (a few
minutes, once), and shaders are compiled again as you play.

## Performance

- **Faster game thread (about −30%)**: the recompiled game code keeps the console's registers in
  local variables instead of memory.
- **Faster render thread (about −40%)**: quicker shader, pipeline and texture lookups, and
  `GX2DrawDone` waits for the GPU only when it really has to.
- **Faster audio**: the two heaviest sound mixing loops run as native code, with the same output
  (game audio thread 15% → 10% of a core on a Mi 9).
- **Big cores**: on devices without a performance hint session (Android 12 and older, or devices
  that refuse one), the game and render threads stay on the big cores. The *CPU cores* setting
  still has the last word.

## Frame rate

- **60 fps keeps the game at full speed**: where an in-between frame doesn't fit in time it is left
  out, so the game never slows down. This replaces *60 fps (adaptive)*; if you had it selected, you
  now get 60 fps.
- **New: 120 fps** on 120 Hz screens (frame interpolation, 3 in-between frames per game step).
- **40 fps** on 120 Hz screens stays as its own option and works as before.
- Better interpolation from the original project: cloth, the night sky's stars and the HD UI
  screens.

*Options → Graphics → Frame rate*: 30, 60 and True 60 everywhere; 120 and 40 fps on 120 Hz
screens.

## Fixes

- **Rito mail sorting game**: the letter card is no longer black.
- **Grandma's shield** with fast scene changes on.
- **Light flashes in Beetle's shop** with Turnip drivers. There is a new *Command recording thread*
  setting (*Options → Graphics*), which applies at the next start.
- **Crashes on some MediaTek devices** (Dimensity 8350): the game code is no longer built with SVE.
- **Arithmetic edge cases** in the game code (integer overflow the game relies on) are handled
  exactly as on the console.
- **Crash logs** are also offered when the app fails before the game starts, or exits in a way the
  crash handler can't catch.

Everything else is as in v1.3.1: see the earlier notes.

## Installing

Install the APK over any earlier version. Requirements: Android 11 or newer, 64-bit ARM,
Vulkan 1.1, about 2 GB of free storage and memory.

If the app crashes, share the log it offers at the next start (or from *About*) with your report.

name: v1.3.1 Enhanced — Performance at high resolutions restored
body:
# v1.3.1 Enhanced — Performance at high resolutions restored

A fix for the frame rate drop some of you saw in v1.3 at internal resolutions above 1x (for example
60 → 54 fps on an Adreno 830 and 30 → 21 fps on an Adreno 725 at 3x).

**The APK contains no game files, no game code and no keys.** It installs over any earlier version
and keeps your saves and settings.

## Fixes

- **Frame rate drop at 2x and 3x resolution.** v1.3 made the game's blur of shadows, ambient
  occlusion and bloom match the console at higher resolutions, which removes a fine grid around
  everything standing on the ground. It read up to 9 times more texels at 3x, and that cost a lot of
  GPU time. It is now **off by default**, so performance is back to v1.2's.

## New setting

- **Console-accurate blur** (*Options → Graphics*, off by default): turns that blur back on, if your
  device has GPU time to spare at your resolution. It now takes 4 reads per tap at 2x to 4x instead of
  up to 16, so it costs much less than in v1.3. It applies at once; at 1x it changes nothing.

Everything else is as in v1.3: see the v1.3 notes.

## Installing

Install the APK over v1.0, v1.1, v1.2 or v1.3. Requirements: Android 11 or newer, 64-bit ARM,
Vulkan 1.1, about 2 GB of free storage and memory.

If the app crashes, share the log it offers at the next start (or from *About*) with your report.

name: v1.3 Enhanced — Picto Box fixed, fast forward, .wua archives, crash reports from the app, smoother 60 fps
body:
# v1.3 Enhanced — Picto Box fixed, fast forward, .wua archives, crash reports from the app, smoother 60 fps

An update to the Enhanced fork of the Android port of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker HD. It
brings in upstream Android port v0.6 and v0.7 and a set of fixes from the original ZeldaWWHDRecomp
project.

**The APK contains no game files, no game code and no keys.** It installs over v1.0, v1.1 or v1.2
and keeps your saves and settings. After updating, the first start compiles the game code on your
device again (a few minutes, once).

## Highlights

- **Picto Box pictures are no longer black.** The pictures the game saves and shows in the Picto
  Box now hold the actual picture.
- **Fast forward cutscenes and dialogues (new).** *Options → Mods → Fast forward cutscenes /
  dialogues*: hold ZR (R2) during a cutscene or a conversation and it plays up to 4× as fast, as
  fast as your device can draw it. Every frame is still played, so nothing is skipped; text boxes
  still wait for your button. Each one is switched on separately.
- **Cemu `.wua` archives as a game source (new).** Put your `.wua` file in the folder you choose
  and the app extracts the game from it, with no keys needed.
- **Crash reports from the app.** After a crash, the next start offers the log in Android's share
  menu; *About* shares the latest logs. They now include the GPU, driver, settings and the game
  function that crashed, and game halts write a log too. No personal data.
- **Bloom strength (new).** *Options → Graphics → Bloom strength*: from Off to 200%; 100% is the
  original game.

## Smoother 60 fps (from the original project)

- **Flags and sails no longer turn into stretched polygons** in the in-between frames (the Rito
  flags on Dragon Roost Island).
- **No more one-frame jumps of carried and attached things**: items in Link's hand, a carried bomb,
  the boat's sail and yard.
- **Night-sky stars stay put** while the camera turns, instead of jittering against the sky.
- **Menus and screen fades run at their normal speed**, and the pause menu always closes.

## Fixes

- **Medli missing from Dragon Roost Island or the Earth Temple** after using the sword cheat: the
  cheat now equips the Master Sword and Mirror Shield without changing your story progress. A save
  already affected can be repaired on a PC with `tools/savegame/wwsave.py repair-medli`.
- **Crash in Tingle's jail on Windfall with quick doors** (*Mods → Quick doors*).
- **Random black shadows for a whole session** on some launches: the lighting buffer could end
  up with a level that was never drawn.
- **A fine grid around everything on the ground at internal resolutions above 1x**: the game's blur
  of shadows, ambient occlusion and bloom now covers the same area as on the console.
- **Shader inputs the vertex shader doesn't write** now get the value the console's GPU gives them,
  instead of undefined values.
- **Copies of depth surfaces at different resolution** no longer use a GPU operation Adreno doesn't
  support for those formats.

## Installing

Install the APK over v1.0, v1.1 or v1.2. New installs: see the v1.0 notes (disc image, disc key
and `common.key` in one folder, then *Extract from your disc image…*), or choose a folder with your
`.wua` archive.

Requirements: Android 11 or newer, 64-bit ARM, Vulkan 1.1, about 2 GB of free storage and memory.
40 fps needs a screen with a 120 Hz mode (the option only shows there).

If the app crashes, share the log it offers at the next start (or from *About*) with your report.

name: v1.2 Enhanced — Hybrid touch layout, sun flare & haze, Japanese version, pause & 40 fps menu fixes
body:
# v1.2 Enhanced — Hybrid touch layout, sun flare & haze, Japanese version, pause & 40 fps menu fixes

An update to the Enhanced fork of the Android port of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker HD,
focused on playing on a single touch screen: the GamePad's touch menus now come up full screen
when you need them, and the pause and menu bugs some of you hit are fixed.

**The APK contains no game files, no game code and no keys.** It installs over v1.0 or v1.1 and keeps your
saves and settings. After updating, the first start compiles the game code on your device again
(a few minutes, once).

## Highlights

- **Hybrid layout (new).** *Options → Layout → Hybrid*: the TV picture full screen while you play,
  and the GamePad's screen full screen whenever a menu is open or you're outside the game (title,
  file select). Items, map, sea chart and save menus work by touch on a single screen; you're back
  on the TV picture as soon as the menu closes. While the GamePad's screen is up, only A, B and
  pause stay on screen, so the rest of the screen is free for the menu.
- **The game's controller select now sets up the app.** Pick *Wii U GamePad* or *Wii U Pro
  Controller* on the game's "Controller select" screen and the app's controls switch to match:
  no more "connect a Pro Controller" wait, and no more touch controls driving the wrong controller.
- **Pro Controller means TV only.** With the Pro Controller the app shows the TV picture only (the
  GamePad's screen is set aside in that mode anyway). Back on the GamePad, your own layout returns.

## Fixes

- **Pause sometimes didn't open, or the pause menu wouldn't close.** Quick taps on the touch
  buttons (shorter than one game frame) could get lost; every tap now reaches the game.
- **Error sound and a stuck pause menu in Pro Controller mode.** Touches on the GamePad's picture
  reached the game, which refuses touch in that mode (error sound) and could get stuck in its menu.
  In Pro Controller mode the game no longer receives GamePad touches.
- **40 fps: menus stuck half closed.** At 40 fps the GamePad's menu could freeze in the middle of
  its closing animation (GamePad screen half dimmed, every menu refused with the error sound), also
  on the way from the file select into the game. Menus, the title and the file select now run at an
  exact 30 fps in 40 fps mode, for a moment after they close too; gameplay stays at 40.
- **No sound after moving the game to the GamePad.** The game's audio for the GamePad's speaker
  wasn't played, so off-TV play ("Currently playing on TV" → move to GamePad) went silent. It now
  plays through your device.

## Graphics and game versions (from upstream v0.5)

- **Sun corona and lens flare are back.** The game checks whether the sun is hidden by reading the
  depth buffer; it now reads the GPU's, so the glare and flare show up as on the console.
- **Distance haze and bloom.** Render targets get a proper mip chain, so the haze over the sea and
  the bloom look right; this also removes the black lines some of you saw in shadows.
- **Japanese version supported**, besides the USA and European ones.
- The second Vulkan recording thread is now used only with the Qualcomm driver (it was slower and
  flickered on Turnip). `WWHD_RECORD_THREAD` still overrides it.

## Stability (from the original ZeldaWWHDRecomp project)

- **Fixed an intermittent crash at boot.** A surface copy could land in memory the game had already
  freed and reused when the renderer was running late; the copy now finishes before the game
  continues.
- Plain `char` is now signed on ARM64, as on the PC and Mac builds the game code is tested on.
- A safety check no longer reads back uncached GPU upload memory (very slow on some drivers).

## Smoother setup

- **First start on a touch-only device**: with no controller attached, the app starts with GamePad
  controls and the hybrid layout.
- **Controller disconnected**: the touch controls come back on their own, and gyro and rumble move
  back to your device.

## Installing

Install the APK over v1.0 or v1.1. New installs: see the v1.0 notes (disc image, disc key and
`common.key` in one folder, then *Extract from your disc image…*).

Requirements: Android 11 or newer, 64-bit ARM, Vulkan 1.1, about 2 GB of free storage and memory.
40 fps needs a screen with a 120 Hz mode (the option only shows there).

If the app crashes, please attach `captures/crash-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.log` from the app's folder
(`Android/data/org.wwhdrecomp.app/files/`) to your report.
